response: Anosov flows and dynamical zeta functions | Annals of Mathematics (https://annals.math.princeton.edu/2013/178-2/p06) citeturn3147search0 [wordlim: 200] Published: 13.0 years ago; Crawled: last week; https://doi.org/10.4007/annals.2013.178.2.6 # Anosov flows and dynamical zeta functions Pages 687-773 from Volume 178 (2013), Issue 2 by Paolo Giulietti, Carlangelo Liverani, Mark Pollicott ### Abstract We study the Ruelle and Selberg zeta functions for $C^r$ Anosov flows, $r > 2$, on a compact smooth manifold. We prove several results, the most remarkable being (a) for $C^\infty$ flows the zeta function is meromorphic on the entire complex plane; (b) for contact flows satisfying a bunching condition (e.g., geodesic flows on manifolds of negative curvature better than $\frac 19$-pinched), the zeta function has a pole at the topological entropy and is analytic in a strip to its left; (c) under the same hypotheses as in (b) we obtain sharp results on the number of periodic orbits. Our arguments are based on the study of the spectral properties of a transfer operator acting on suitable Banach spaces of anisotropic currents. Des résultats plus généraux ont été récemment obtenus par Giulietti-Liverani-Pollicott [?] mais notre approche est diﬀérente et se base sur l'étude du générateur du ﬂot, que l'on considère comme un opérateur pseudodiﬀérentiel semi- ique. The purpose of this paper is to give a short microlocal proof of the meromorphic continuation of the Ruelle zeta function for $C^\infty $ Anosov ﬂows.
